description.value: A last-resort marker system stitched around the heart; somewhere out there a patron is owed, and this is the collateral. Reaction, once per week, when reduced below half HP: instantly and without a save, neutralize one enemy in the encounter as enforcers you never see do the work. Triggering it obligates you to complete a job for the patron within 30 days — miss the window, and the implant seizes the heart once, no save, for Grade-5-surgery's worth of damage before going dormant.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability is a once-per-week reaction that instantly neutralizes an enemy with no save, targeting another creature's condition from a self-held item -- same architecture gap as Grave-Quiet/Loyal-Blood, compounded by a narrative 30-day-job obligation and a follow-up heart-seizure consequence, neither of which has any schema representation.
